title: Work out total pay
prompt: For every employee, return first_name and total_pay. total_pay is the salary plus the bonus, where the bonus is salary * bonus_pct / 100. An employee with no bonus_pct gets no bonus, so their total_pay is their salary.
hints: What does the calculation give for an employee whose bonus_pct is NULL?
Replace a missing percentage with 0 before it is used.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Lets a missing percentage turn the whole total into NULL.
Leaves out the employees who have no bonus.

feedback: Find an employee with no bonus_pct in your result. Their total_pay should equal their salary.
